name: xBank Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to feedback from multiple community members, the zkSync ecosystem lending platform @xBankFinance is suspected of a rug pull. Currently, the official account displays that it has been frozen, and the platform's liquidity is reduced to single-digit assets.
